tweets: Virupaksha Temple, Hampi — in worship since the 7th century, 1,300 years unbroken. Its gopuram, raised by Kṛṣṇadevarāya in 1510, hides a quiet trick of light: a tiny aperture casts the towers inverted shadow on an inner wall, a camera obscura centuries before the word existed.
